final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM district_counts), district_shares AS (SELECT dc.district_id, dc.count, CAST(dc.count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as share FROM district_counts dc CROSS JOIN total_count tc WHERE tc.total IS NOT NULL), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM district_shares) SELECT ds.district_id, ds.count, ds.share, ds.share - av.avg_share as difference FROM district_shares ds CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc av WHERE av.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
